cases.annotation: indeterminate / PASSPORT_KEY_NOT_FOUND with key_authority "unresolved" is what the SDK at the pinned commit returns when the resolver finds no key. It applies the draft-04 section 3.5 mapping, written for external and evidence signers, to the agent's own key. Section 3.1 assigns no outcome for the agent's own key, so an implementation that reports invalid here is not nonconforming on this vector alone. The first revision of this family recorded invalid. layers.key_authority is unresolved: no key was resolved.

cases.annotation: unsupported is what the SDK at the pinned commit returns for a string record_type or version it does not recognise, the rule draft-04 states for the delegation and revocation record families. Section 3.1 does not assign an outcome to an unrecognised profile, so an implementation that reports invalid or malformed here is not nonconforming on this vector alone. The first revision of this family recorded invalid / PASSPORT_MALFORMED. What this vector establishes is that the record must not be admitted.

limits: Finite printable-ASCII corpus reader; not general JCS conformance.
Signature verification uses cryptography/OpenSSL; no independent cryptographic-backend claim.
Agreement on the five annotated cases follows the producer's revision 2 outputs; draft-04 does not require those outcomes.
Resolver answers are supplied synthetic data, without historical validity windows or authenticated lookup.
No APS package qualification, principal binding, live DID lookup, host adoption, federation enrollment or commercial agreement.
